metaDescription: Validate CNPJ online using the official check-digit algorithm.

form.title: Validate CNPJ

seo.about: The validator checks length, rejects repeated sequences, and recalculates the two CNPJ check digits.
seo.howToUse: Type or paste the CNPJ. The tool removes punctuation automatically and shows whether the check digits match.
